Chapter 501 - 501 Gift; Choice (2)

Chapter 501 - 501 Gift; Choice (2)

501 Gift; Choice (2)

A big client!

This was definitely a rare big client!

Lin Fan nodded at the blonde attendant as a form of greeting.

When he saw Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Liu Qianqian, Nie Zhenjiang, and the others, he was slightly stunned and smiled. “Why are you guys here?”

“Professor Lin!” Hao Zhiwu shouted excitedly.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue said shyly, “Professor Lin.”

Wan Fei, who was about to continue showing off, looked at Lin Fan in confusion. “Liu Qianqian, is that someone you know?”

“He’s our professor,” Liu Qianqian explained.

“Professor? So young?” Wan Fei said in surprise.

After all, most university professors were middle-aged and elderly people over the age of 40 or 50.

How old was Lin Fan?

He was only in his 20s.

Lin Fan ignored her shock and said, “It’s rare for us to be overseas, so I bought you some small gifts. Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, and Hao Zhiwu, these are for the three of you.”

As he spoke, he handed over three Vacheron Constantin watch boxes.

“A gift? Thank you, Professor!” Hao Zhiwu said excitedly.

Then, he quickly opened the box and took out a well-made watch that looked very calm and fashionable.

Hao Zhiwu fell in love with it at first glance.

“What a cool watch!” he praised sincerely.

The blonde attendant’s heart skipped a beat.

Vacheron Constantin’s Traditionelle! The market price was 150,000 euros!

He casually gave away a watch worth 150,000 euros!

As expected, this was a great customer!

“What a great watch!”

At this time, Jiang Chaoqun also opened the watch box, revealing a low-key, luxurious watch.

The blonde attendant looked over, and his heart skipped a beat.

Vacheron Constantin 5370P! The market price was 150,000 euros!

Another watch worth 150,000 yuan!

“What a beautiful watch!” Nie Zhenjiang took out his watch and praised.

The blonde attendant looked over, and his heart raced again.

Vacheron Constantin Lange 760! The market price was 150,000 euros!

Someone with a watch worth 150,000 euros was a big client.

What if it was someone who casually gave away three watches worth 150,000 euros?

A god-level customer!

This was definitely a god-tier customer that he rarely met in a year!

The blonde attendant could not help but lower his body even more.

The fair-skinned attendant not far away also bent down.

It was all out of respect for the god-level customer.

Wan Fei only knew LV, Gucci, Chanel…

She did not know much about Vacheron Constantin watches.

She sneered and said, “I said that your professor would buy gifts for you. Look, he’s giving you a few watches. They look quite nice. They should be worth dozens or hundreds of euros, right?”

When the fair-skinned and blonde attendants heard this, they all swept their sharp gazes over.

Hundreds of euros?

Was she mocking a god-level customer?

If the god-level customer was unhappy because of this and left the shop, what should they do?

One had to know…

Cartier stores had performance requirements.

Only when the staff and the store achieved a certain level of performance could they get the corresponding commissions.

Such a god-level customer would undoubtedly bring a lot of business to the staff and the shop.

The middle-aged man hurriedly berated Wan Fei in a low voice, “Don’t talk nonsense. Those watches are from Vacheron Constantin!”

Obviously, he still had some understanding of watches.

He understood that the other party must have extraordinary strength to casually give away three pieces of Vacheron Constantin.

He definitely could not be easily offended.

The middle-aged man saw that Wan Fei was still a little confused. He said again, “The cheapest watch from Vacheron Constantin costs tens of thousands, or even more than a hundred thousand Chinese dollars!”

“What?” Wan Fei said in surprise.

The cheapest watch was worth tens of thousands or even a hundred thousand yuan?

He directly gave away three watches…

This…

However, when Wan Fei saw the LV bag by her waist, the Chanel bracelet on her wrist, and the Cartier necklace on her neck… she slowly recovered.

Were they not just three Vacheron Constantin watches?

They must be the cheapest models!

Her bag, bracelet, necklace… They were all worth tens of thousands of yuan!

Lin Fan ignored Wan Fei’s thoughts and continued, “Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Liu Qianqian, I’ll buy your gifts from Cartier. Did you see anything you like?”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue kept their heads buried.

Liu Qianqian shook her head gently.

She had just learned the price of Cartier from Wan Fei, so she did not dare to like the things here.

They were too expensive!

Lin Fan turned to the blonde attendant and asked, “Do you have any recommendations?”

The blonde attendant hurriedly said in Chinese, “Esteemed guest, this way, please.”

He brought Lin Fan to the high-end area.

Then, he took out a necklace.

The long chain was inlaid with dense diamonds. Under the light, it was like a galaxy, shining with dazzling light. Coupled with the heart-shaped diamond pendant, it vaguely formed a heart-shaped galaxy. It was very beautiful.

With just one glance, Liu Qianqian was stunned.

Beautiful!

It was too beautiful!

“This necklace is called the Heart of the Milky Way,” the blonde attendant introduced. “It was made by the famous designer Brewer Kearns. The necklace is made up of 100 diamonds and a two-carat heart-shaped diamond.

“It’s like a flowing galaxy. The heart is bright, symbolizing beautiful love…”

“The Heart of the Milky Way is priced at 182,000 euros.”

Liu Qianqian, who was originally intoxicated by the necklace, immediately woke up when she heard the price.

182,000 euros! If converted, it was close to 1.3 million yuan!

It was equivalent to a house!

It was simply terrifying!

Not only Liu Qianqian, but Hao Zhiwu, Nie Zhenjiang, and Jiang Chaoqun were also shocked by the price.

Even Wan Fei, who had been showing off her LV bag and Chanel bracelet, was shocked.

Lin Fan did not react at all.

He easily noticed that Liu Qianqian liked the necklace and nodded slightly.

Then, he pointed at Xia Bing and Xia Xue. He asked, “Do they have any recommendations for them?”

The blonde attendant looked at where Lin Fan was pointing and praised sincerely, “What beautiful twins.”

After thinking for a moment, he took out two bracelets from the cabinet.

One was made of sapphire, pure and natural.

Another was made of ruby, fiery and bright.

The two were of the same style but different colors. They were like siblings, each with their own characteristics.

“These two bracelets are called the Blue Enchantress,” the blonde attendant explained. “One bracelet is made of 19 small natural sapphires and one large natural sapphire, while the other is made of 19 natural rubies and one large natural ruby. All the gemstones have not been carved or modified. They are the most beautiful gifts of nature!

“The Blue Enchantress was discovered by the American scientific research team and later created by the Swiss designer, Maitreya.

“The blue enchantress flower symbolizes pure and innocent love. It’s exactly the same as the bracelets. In fact, the bracelets even have a touch of unique beauty compared to the flower!

“In the past, I always thought that the Blue Enchantress would be sold to a certain customer so that she would display different charms in different clothes!

“Now, I feel that… perhaps the Blue Enchantress was made for these two beauties.”

It was unknown if it was because they had listened to the blonde attendant or because Xia Bing and Xia Xue really liked the bracelets.

They looked at the bracelets with their beautiful eyes, and there was a faint light flashing in them.

Obviously, they were very interested in the Blue Enchantress.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan nodded his head.

At this time, the blonde attendant said, “Because these gemstones are very rare, and they were made by Master Maitreya, the price of these two bracelets is relatively expensive. Each bracelet is priced at 390,000 euros.”

Hiss!

Everyone gasped when they heard this!

390,000 euros!

If it was converted, that would be 2.8 million yuan!

It would be 5.6 million yuan for two!

This was definitely a terrifying number!

Lin Fan’s expression remained the same.

He nodded again and said, “Okay, then I’ll take this necklace and these two bracelets.”

Lin Fan’s voice was so relaxed and calm.

It was as if he was just talking about buying two packets of tissues. He did not care at all.
